content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to adjust the threshold on the [product_name] display during operation? I would like users to be able to modify the number of operations for a function while in run mode. Best regards, [user_name]
Yes, you can do this through the 'parameter' menu. The value can be changed while [product_name] is operational.
It's true, but using ESC and similar steps takes a long time to change a number. Is there an alternative method to make this process quicker?
Hello, I've attached an example showing one way to accomplish this task. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are exploring ways to modify the threshold value on a [product_name] display while the system is live. Although adjustments are possible, the current process is seen as rather slow and inefficient. The core issue revolves around enhancing the workflow to allow quicker, more convenient parameter changes during operation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for a faster and simpler solution to update counter values on the [product_name] display when the system is running, aiming to improve efficiency and ease of use.
